attributes.context: The provision is Section 16, titled “Maintenance of Work Provision,” appearing on page 43 between the contracting out provision and the personal automobile mileage provision.

extraction_text: The Company will maintain work done by employees in the past, except when in the interest of progress changes in the methods of production, distribution, sales or office procedure are contemplated which will affect the wages, hours or working conditions of the employees. In such case, a meeting to facilitate an agreement will be held with proper representatives of the Union before the new methods are placed into effect.

attributes.context: This provision appears in Article IX, Dismissal Pay. It establishes dismissal pay eligibility when a job is abolished because of conversion to straight natural gas or plant disposition, requires at least two years of Company seniority beginning before the change was put into effect, and is followed by a statement that terminations due to lack of work, business conditions, economies, or retrenchments are not covered.

extraction_text: If and when any job is abolished as a result of the conversion to straight natural gas or the sale, lease, or other disposition of a manufacturing plant of the Company, then an employee whose employment was terminated because of the abolition of such job is eligible to receive dismissal pay if, at the time of the termination of his employment, he had at least two (2) years of Company seniority which began on or before the time such change was put into effect.
